title: fix(platform-objects): Rotate Client Secret result dialog states the immediate cut-off, not a grace period
body:
Fixes #24774

Clause-②: no (text only: no accept set, served shape or behaviour moves)

Dispatched by the `domain:engine` seat 1 PM (`session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy`, claim 6289452299). Developer session: `session_01MrvwG9BMeMc4oCSG9FsV95`.

## What rotation does to the previous secret (read first)

- `POST /api/v1/auth/oauth2/client/rotate-secret` is better-auth's own route. `plugin-auth` only lists it in `auth-route-ledger.ts`, and nothing in this repository wraps it.
- In the pinned `@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.3, `rotateClientSecretEndpoint` (`dist/authorize-9whjxVLJ.mjs`) generates a new secret and runs one `adapter.update` that **overwrites** the client's single `clientSecret` column. No previous secret is stored anywhere.
- Client authentication, `validateClientCredentials` (`dist/utils-oOcdCCVw.mjs`), checks a presented secret against that one stored `client.clientSecret` through `verifyStoredClientSecret`. There is no second value to match.
- **Result: an immediate cut-off.** The old secret is refused from the moment the rotation's update commits. No grace period exists. The code leaves no doubt, so no booted measurement was made.
- No document promises a window. `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` already says "The current secret stops working immediately". So the confirmation was true and the result dialog was false. The behaviour itself is not in question here.

## Change

- `sys-oauth-application.object.ts`, `rotate_client_secret`:
  - `description` (the confirmation) is unchanged. It was already true.
  - `resultDialog.description` now reads "Save the new secret now — it is shown only once. The previous secret has already stopped working: update every integration with the new secret." The shown-once sentence, the title, the acknowledgement and the `client_secret` field are kept.
  - A comment names the handler and why there is no grace period.
- Translation bundles:
  - `en.objects.generated.ts` was regenerated with `pnpm i18n:extract`, and only that one line moved.
  - `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES` all carried a translated grace-period sentence. These are hand-written translated values, not byte copies, so they have no source-hash entry. The extractor keeps them in merge mode, and the staleness rule ("a path with no entry is LEGACY-TRUSTED and never reported stale") would never flag them. So I re-translated the value by hand in each locale. No keys were added or dropped. `check:i18n` is in sync.

## Pins

- New `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/rotate-client-secret-copy.test.ts`:
  - in the source, the confirmation says the previous secret "will stop working immediately", the result dialog says it "has already stopped working", and neither text mentions a grace period, a window or an expiry;
  - the result dialog keeps its shown-once sentence, its acknowledgement and its secret field;
  - the `en` bundle mirrors the source;
  - in each of the four locales, neither text promises a grace period (`宽限`, `猶予`, `gracia` and similar words), and each translated result dialog is a real translation, not the English text.
- Normally this repo does not pin copy. It does here because the card's defect is the wording itself, and the card asked for the pins.
- **Ablation**, with the fix committed, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each mutation was confirmed on disk, and each restore was proven by blob hash against HEAD. There is no dist leg: the test imports `src` relatively.
  - Source leg: the old grace-period sentence put back into `resultDialog.description` (blob `d5ffc56c6b52` to `4f08d6f86141`). **2 failed, 2 passed (4).** The source-agreement test and the `en`-mirror test went red. Restored to `d5ffc56c6b52`.
  - Locale leg: the old zh-CN grace-period sentence put back (blob `65c34bca849d` to `0b3f3e584462`). **1 failed, 3 passed (4):** `zh-CN resultDialog.description promises a grace period`. Restored to `65c34bca849d`.
- **Pin sweep:** I searched every package, `qa/`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` and `content/docs/` for the old and new strings and for `rotate_client_secret`.
  - `action-confirm-one-dialog.test.ts` pins the unchanged confirmation ("stop working immediately", "shown only once"). It stays green and does not move.
  - No other pin reads the result-dialog text. No `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` item names this action.

## Verification record

Base `abd5acdaf7`, merged with `origin/main` `9a06f0be0` before opening (the merge touched nothing in `platform-objects`). All results are on head `c41eb1949`.

| Command | Result |
|:---|:---|
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck` | exit 0. The new test is in `tsconfig.test.json`'s program (`--listFiles`: 1 hit). |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test` (full suite) | exit 0, 80 files, 1203 tests passed |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test:repo` | exit 0, 6 files, 82 tests passed |
| `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` (whole workspace, docs excluded, after the merge) | exit 0, 76 of 76 tasks |
| `vitest run` of `runtime`'s `src/action-execution-destructive.test.ts` (this action's consumer test), against the rebuilt `platform-objects` dist | exit 0, 63 passed |
| `vitest run` of `cli`'s `test/platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts` and `test/i18n-extract-action-description.test.ts` | exit 0, 34 passed |
| `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 66 derived commands, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe | 66 of 66 exit 0. `--ran` (each line recorded as `COMMAND :: exit CODE`): "66 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 66 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)" |

On the first run, `check:i18n` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no `dist/`). I built the whole workspace, and both then exited 0.

## Siblings

This PR regenerates one line of the `platform-objects` `en` bundle and changes one value in each of the three translated bundles. Whichever of #24758, #24765 and this one lands second re-derives the bundles with `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`.

## Acceptance notes

- The YAML example in `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` ("Create via API with secret reveal") gives `target: /api/v1/auth/sys-oauth-application/rotate-secret`. That is not the route the shipped action calls (`/api/v1/auth/oauth2/client/rotate-secret`). It is an illustrative docs example, and its own copy already says the cut-off is immediate. Noted, not filed.
